input.summary: USAG Fort Brannock BOS PWS (W9131B-27-R-0006). TE 5 Part A: 48 rows registered (47 serviced facilities, 1,060,920 GSF / 557,560 CSF; Bldg 1407 vacant and programmed for demolition, out of scope). TE 5 Part B: 2 optional facilities (1410, 3116; 103,000 GSF / 40,160 CSF design estimates) as option_only (CLIN 0010). Grounds: TE 6 Table 6-1 (83.1 AC improved, 173.9 AC semi-improved, 302.5 AC unimproved; G-13 RCI family housing 146.0 AC excluded), Table 6-2 athletic fields 11.6 AC, Table 6-3 beds 58,400 SF, parking 131,800 SY, sidewalks 196,300 SF, edging 54,600 LF. Prior contract W9131B-22-C-0003 (Northwoods Integrated Services, LLC), $38,947,260 over 60 months, excluding pest management (CLS 510, separate contract). No dining scope (DFAC 1310 is under the installation food service contract).
unresolved: Buildings named in the PWS text but not in TE 5 and stated as not serviced under CLS 402 (PWS 1.2.1, 5.1.13): Army Health Clinic 1100, Veterinary Treatment Facility 1106, Dining Facility 1310, Brannock Club 1550, Commissary 1600, and family housing. Not registered; they appear only in the refuse, snow and pest exhibits (TE 7, TE 8, TE 9).

Table 3-1 Government-Furnished Facilities (2410 7,200 GSF; 2412 12,800 GSF; 2414 4,000 GSF; 2416 6,360 GSF): PWS 3.2.1 says the Contractor shall perform custodial services in GFF at no additional cost, but they are not in TE 5, are not invoiced under CLIN 0002, and are not serviced under CLS 402 (5.1.13). Not registered as workload. Carry the self-cleaning as overhead.
TE 5 Part B GSF and CSF are design estimates (Note 12), to be adjusted to as-built CSF when CLIN 0010 is exercised.
Bldgs 1520 and 1524: the TE 5 hard floor SF includes wood gym floors (14,200 and 11,600 SF, Note 10). floor_areas split wood out of the hard floor figure.

Snow and ice removal roads (50.8 lane-miles, TE 8 Table 8-1) cannot be registered as grounds areas. TE 8 Table 8-2 (115,600 SY parking, 172,500 SF walks) is a subset of TE 6 Table 6-3 and was not registered separately. TE 9 Table 9-2 pest areas overlap TE 6 and were not registered.
